findings.message: A media object holds fewer bytes than the block alignment of 120; a decoder takes it for the rest of a packet and reads no header in it: it drops the superframe that goes on from the packet before, and takes a superframe or the start of one from the bytes only where the packet before counted more superframes than it held, or none (wmavoice.c).
